method: Sampled 30 chapters x 1 random tariff_line each. DB row fetched via Supabase (project waowoznsvaosgcgiivzo). PDF row located by reading the exact PDF page as image (PDF tabular layout) to avoid pdftotext column-wrap artifacts. Verified description (word-recall), export_policy (cell value), policy_condition (text in policy-condition cell). Notification number/date columns were not counted as policy_condition for this audit.

verdict_explanation: All 30 codes were located in the source PDF and all 30 descriptions matched verbatim (CLEAN on description axis). However, on the export_policy axis the DB has systematically null/empty values where the PDF clearly shows 'Free', 'Restricted', or 'Prohibited' in the dedicated Export Policy column. 25 of 30 sampled rows are missing the export_policy field (and several also miss the policy_condition cell text). This is a systematic ingestion-loss issue, not isolated OCR errors. Where the DB does have export_policy populated (e.g. 1006.30.12, 5205.26.20, 8543.40.00, 9027.89.30, 9403.91.00) the value and policy_condition are correct. Recommendation: re-run the policy-column ingestion against the PDFs; the description column is reliable, the policy columns are not.
